result.summary: The page renders cleanly overall: header, search bar, category chips, promo banner, and restaurant cards are aligned and legible. No critical defects found. A few minor cosmetic/styling observations were noted.

issues.description: Food imagery in the 'Fastest near you' cards appears as generic illustration placeholders rather than actual restaurant photos, which can look inconsistent.
issues.suggestion: Ensure restaurant photos load or fall back to a consistent placeholder; mixed illustration/photo styles can look unfinished.

issues.description: In the promo banner, the text 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10' has the separator dot sitting close to surrounding text, slightly reducing readability at small sizes.
issues.suggestion: Add slight spacing around the dot separator or use a middle-dot with padding for better readability.

issues.description: The notification bell icon has a badge but no visible label; its purpose is not obvious to all users.
issues.suggestion: Add a content description to the notification icon so screen readers can identify it.
